more_beautiful.reason: B is more polished and cohesive at both widths (brush-script title with a cinnabar stroke, larger and clearer type, tidy rounded cards, a strong full-width red button), whereas A's class cards have an awkward inner layout with single orphaned characters (字, 书) on their own lines, and its desktop form column has inputs of different widths next to a mostly empty left column.

less_generic.reason: A's 米字格 practice-grid squares (in the logo and as the 楷/行 class icons) come from how calligraphy is actually practised and look deliberately chosen, while B uses the stock Chinese-style kit (red seal, brush-font title, brush underline, cinnabar button) on top of a standard two-card form template that could pass for AI or template output.
